notes: No model in examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/ or model code reads this class (repo-wide grep; only earth2studio/data, lexicon, CHANGELOG and docs/modules/datasources_analysis.md mention it), so winning_model is null and variables are the source lexicon. Full NClimGridLexicon.VOCAB (earth2studio/lexicon/nclimgrid.py:36-41), 4 variables.

Valid from 1951-01-01, daily; time of day ignored (nclimgrid.py:401). All variables for one day come from one monthly file access/grids/2024/ncdd-202401-grd-scaled.nc (about 65 MB), so cost is nearly independent of variable count.
